title: Prototype to Production
summary: 本文档概述了将AI Agent从原型到生产环境部署的关键步骤和最佳实践，强调自动化、安全性和互操作性，旨在帮助Al/ML工程师、DevOps专业人员和系统架构师。

core_concepts.name: Evaluation-Gated Deployment
core_concepts.definition: 强调任何Agent版本在没有通过全面的评估测试之前，不应该被发布给用户。这种预生产阶段的目标是将手动的不确定性替换为自动化的信心。

core_concepts.name: CI/CD Pipeline for AI Agents
core_concepts.definition: AI Agent包含代码、prompt、工具定义和配置文件，CI/CD pipeline 用于确保这些组件的质量和一致性，通过分阶段测试，在Agent发布给用户之前建立信心。

core_concepts.name: Infrastructure as Code (laC)
core_concepts.definition: 使用Terraform等工具以编程方式定义环境，确保环境的相同性、可重复性和版本控制。
key_points: Terraform configurations for complete agent infrastructure including Vertex AI, Cloud Run, and BigQuery resources

core_concepts.name: Secure Al Agents (SAIF)
core_concepts.definition: 构建安全AI Agent的框架，通过三层防御来应对Agent的独特风险。
key_points: Policy Definition and System Instructions (The Agent's Constitution)
Guardrails, Safeguards, and Filtering (The Enforcement Layer)

core_concepts.name: AgentOps Lifecycle
core_concepts.definition: 运营Al Agents的核心方法论，包括观察(Observe)，行动(Act)和进化(Evolve)三个阶段，用于保证 Al Agents 的可靠，安全和高效。
key_points: Act: The Levers of Operational Control

core_concepts.name: A2A (Agent2Agent) Protocol
core_concepts.definition: 用于智能Agent之间进行复杂、有状态的协作的协议，通过Agent Cards来实现Agent的发现和连接。

core_concepts.name: MCP (Model Context Protocol)
core_concepts.definition: 提供工具集成的通用标准，适用于简单、无状态的函数，例如获取天气数据或查询数据库。
key_points: Tools and resources—primitives with well-defined, structured inputs and outputs

best_practices.description: 通过渐进式发布降低风险，并进行仔细监控。
best_practices.example: Canary, Blue-Green, A/B Testing, Feature Flags

best_practices.practice: Managing Risk: The Security Response Playbook
best_practices.description: 制定快速containment的剧本，当检测到威胁时，响应应遵循一个清晰的序列：contain，triage，and resolve。
best_practices.example: 使用“circuit breaker”立即禁用受影响的工具

architecture_patterns.description: 最强大的agentic 系统在分层架构中使用这两种协议。应用程序可能主要使用A2A来协调多个智能代理之间的高级协作，而每个代理在内部使用MCP与其自身特定的一组工具和资源进行交互。
使用类似MCP的协议来编目所有资产，从函数到API。创建精选列表，而不是让代理访问数千个工具，从而产生三种常见的模式：Generalist agents, Specialist agents, Dynamic agents.

code_snippets.description: A sample agent card for the check_prime_agent
Using the ADK's to_a2a utility to wrap an existing agent and expose it for A2A communication
code_snippets.code:
# Example using ADK: Exposing an agent via A2A
from google.adk.a2a.utils.agent_to_a2a import to_a2a

# Your existing agent
root_agent = Agent(
    name='hello_world_agent',
    # your agent code ...
)

# Make it A2A-compatible
a2a_app = to_a2a(root_agent, port=8001)

# Serve with uvicorn
# uvicorn agent:a2a_app --host localhost --port 8001
# Or serve with Agent Engine
# from vertexai.preview.reasoning_engines import A2aAgent

# )

code_snippets.description: Using the ADK's RemoteA2aAgent class to connect to and consume a remote agent
code_snippets.code:
# Example using ADK: Consuming a remote agent via A2A
from google.adk.agents.remote_a2a_agent import RemoteA2aAgent

prime_agent = RemoteA2aAgent(
    name="prime_agent",
    description="Agent that handles checking if numbers are prime.",
    agent_card="http://localhost:8001/a2a/check_prime_agent/\.well-known/agent-card.json"
)

code_snippets.description: Using a remote A2A agent (prime_agent) as a sub-agent within a hierarchical agent structure in the ADK
code_snippets.code:
# Example using ADK: Hierarchical agent composition
# ADK Local sub-agent for dice rolling
roll_agent = Agent(
    name="roll_agent",
    instruction="You are an expert at rolling dice."
)

# ADK Remote A2A agent for prime checking
prime_agent = RemoteA2aAgent(
    name="prime_agent",
    agent_card="http://localhost:8001/\.well-known/agent-card.json"
)

# ADK Root orchestrator combining both
root_agent = Agent(
    name="root_agent",
    instruction='"Delegate rolling dice to roll_agent, prime checking to prime_agent."'",
    sub_agents=[roll_agent, prime_agent]
)

key_takeaways: 构建 Al Agents 需要关注 infrastructure, security, validation, 而不仅仅是核心智能
需要构建 Automated Evaluation, Automated Deployment (CI/CD), 和 Comprehensive Observability 的基石
要实现 Al Agents 之间的互操作性，需要遵循 A2A 和 MCP 协议
